contexts.text: By a mile () is signified that which leads to truth; for the like is signified by a mile as by a way.

Whosoever shall compel thee to one mile, go with him two () = that if anyone wants to lead away from truth to falsity and from good to evil, he is not to be opposed, because he cannot do it. By a mile the like is signified as by a way; namely that which leads away and leads.
